datasets.caveat: Original LP paper provides no LER plot/rate grid/numeric iteration cap for1054. Controlled prospective depolarizing grid0.02,0.04,0.06,0.08,0.10,0.12. Budget32 and scale0.625 borrowed from cited BP-OSD paper, whose schedule is layered; this study uses canonical flooding. No original LP paper curve ordinates exist to compare. Original LP Example4, depolarizing code capacity. Q-BP, tuning, Relay and beam are canonical adaptations. Search128 is explicitly4x the documented BP cap. No native runtime or statistical paper agreement is claimed before confirmation.
